frases: Your raised bed is about to burst open!
Hit like and follow. Flo filled this one to the top!
Tall boards, four corners, and lots of soil. Perfect!
Wet soil is heavy, and it pushes out on every wall.
The middle of the long side takes the most push. That's where it bows first.
So I just need thicker boards?
Thicker helps. But the real fix is a tie across the middle.
A board or a threaded rod, from one long side to the other. It holds both walls in.
Longer than eight feet? Use two ties.
Strong corner posts, screwed, not nailed. And sink them into the ground.
Fine. My garden bed is wearing a belt.
